verdict.rationale: Missive documents rules and automations, including up to 1000 rules and multi-step rules with delays, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those rules. The general activity log ('every action within Missive is logged') is an adjacent audit feature, not automation versioning or rollback, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
